mapper.sql: id, app_id, service_key, desired_json, pending_delete, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from platform_app_service where app_id = #{appId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by id asc

select s.id, s.app_id, s.service_key, s.desired_json, s.pending_delete, s.version, s.created_at, s.updated_at from platform_app_service s join platform_application a on a.id = s.app_id where a.cluster_id = #{clusterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.deleted_at is null and s.desired_json like '%"nodePort"%'
mapper.insert: insert into platform_app_service (app_id, service_key, desired_json, pending_delete, version, created_at, updated_at) values (#{appId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{serviceKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{desiredJson,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, coalesce(#{pendingDelete,jdbcType=TINYINT}, 0), 0, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
